title: ID0402379-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / SN 170004220] EcoG error (C1)
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The EcoG is sending a lot of data in the logs.  This is happening after/under a charge session. The charger is not sending a StopTransaction via OCPP after the car stops the charge and the light on the charger outlet switched between white and blue and cant be used. If we do a reset of the charger then everything is back to normal for some time. This have happened tree times in January month so far.

Yes- 0399323 but different issue

additional_info.subject: Escalation started
additional_info.body:
Topic has been escalated. R&D has been requested to take actions on case EVC3-8443.
Further updates will be reported in this ISP ticket.
The charger had the issue again February 8.

additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body:
The fault has been acknowledged by R&D and reported to EcoG.
As per confirmed by R&D, data collection and fault reproduction is needed, as current data in SCB logs is not sufficient.
Furthermore, rebooting has the unfortunate effect of erasing the needed EcoG files.
Therefore, ES and RC agreed that the charger won't be rebooted next time failure happens, so that EcoG logs and dump data can be retrieved and analysed by R&D and EcoG.
HW failure seems unreasonable at this stage and EcoG replacement won't have any benefit; however, this will be verified with EcoG.
ES and RC-DK will align on planning further testing
